items:
30A Escapes presents… “HollieBird House”, your slice of paradise in Watersound West. Freshly updated, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort and style. Wake up to the sound of ocean breezes, stroll down a private path to sugar-white sands, and let time slow down as you bike scenic trails (4 bikes included!). This 3-bedroom retreat, designed for up to 11 guests, feels like home with a touch of magic—coastal charm, cozy spaces, and room to gather or simply breathe. Tucked in a gated haven, this is where memories unfold. Your getaway starts here! Learn more below…👇

★☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ Newly Furnished and Updated Home - Enjoy modern comfort and style in a home that’s been freshly updated with brand-new furnishings.
✔ Steps to Private Beach Walk-Over - Experience the ultimate serenity with easy access to a secluded beach, just moments away from your doorstep.
✔ Resort-Style Pool Across the Street - Dive into relaxation at the luxurious pool, perfect for unwinding after a day of adventures.
✔ Gated Watersound West Community - Enjoy peace of mind and exclusivity in this prestigious, secure coastal community.
✔ Multiple Outdoor Entertaining Spaces - Host unforgettable gatherings or simply soak up the sun in beautifully designed outdoor areas.
✔ Sleeps 11 Comfortably with 3 Suites - Bring the whole family or a group of friends—there’s plenty of space for everyone to relax in comfort.

Eager to Read More?
Here Are a Few Kind Words from Our Previous Guests:

⭐ "Amazing location in WaterSound West! The kids absolutely loved being so close to the pool. The house was spotless, beautifully maintained, and perfect for our family. We’d definitely stay here again!" - Davy
⭐ "The property couldn’t have been more convenient—right next to the pool and just a short stroll to the beach. The house was fantastic, and we’ll absolutely book this property again if it’s available!" - Tim
⭐ "The neighborhood was peaceful, the house was absolutely stunning, and the location was unbeatable. It had everything we needed for a flawless vacation. Truly a dream getaway!" - Allen

★☆ LIVING AREA ☆★

A welcoming open floor plan creates a bright and inviting living space perfect for relaxation and quality time. The spacious main living area features ample seating for everyone, adorned with stylish and comfortable furnishings. Large windows flood the room with natural light, highlighting the beautiful hardwood flooring throughout the home. Additionally, a cozy living room on the 3rd floor offers an extra space to unwind or entertain.

✔ Spacious and inviting living room featuring a large, cozy sectional - perfect for relaxing or entertaining
✔ Bright and airy open-concept design seamlessly connecting the living, kitchen, and dining areas for effortless flow
✔ Dedicated office nook, ideal for remote work, studying, or quiet reflection
✔ Bonus living room on the 3rd floor offering additional space for relaxation, entertainment, or family time

★☆ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

The fully equipped kitchen boasts premium stainless-steel appliances, sleek modern fixtures, and an abundance of counter space, perfect for all your culinary creations. The adjoining dining area offers elegant seating for six, complemented by additional seating for two at the stylish kitchen island, creating a seamless space to cook, dine, and entertain effortlessly.

✔ Premium stainless-steel appliances for seamless and efficient meal preparation
✔ Elegant dining table seating for 6, complemented by a stylish island with seating for 2
✔ Outdoor side patio featuring a high-end grill and a dining table for 6, perfect for al fresco meals
✔ Meticulously designed with modern, sleek finishes and a highly functional, open layout

★☆ OUTDOOR OASIS ☆★

Experience the ultimate in outdoor living with multiple serene spaces designed to let you fully embrace the Florida sunshine. Start your day with a fresh cup of coffee on the tranquil screened-in porch, surrounded by nature. After a fun-filled beach day, refresh yourself in the luxurious private outdoor shower. Every detail of this home is crafted to provide the perfect blend of comfort, style, and premium outdoor enjoyment.

✔ Luxurious resort-style community pool just steps from your front door
✔ Relax on the screened-in porch or entertain in the expansive outdoor living spaces
✔ Enjoy the convenience of a private outdoor shower, perfect after beach days
✔ Explore 30A’s stunning scenic trails with 4 included cruiser bikes

★☆ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

This stunning home accommodates up to 11 guests, featuring elegant, spacious bedrooms and meticulously designed bathrooms. Every detail has been crafted to ensure you wake up feeling refreshed, rejuvenated, and ready to enjoy your stay.

1st Floor
✔ Guest Bathroom: Conveniently located for easy access, perfect for visitors or quick stops

2nd Floor
✔ Primary Suite: Luxurious king bed with a private en-suite featuring a soaking tub, double vanity, glass-enclosed shower, and a chic makeup vanity—your personal retreat
✔ Queen Guest Suite 1: Comfortable queen bed with a private en-suite, including a sleek glass-enclosed shower
✔ Queen Guest Suite 2: Cozy queen bed with access to a shared hall bathroom featuring a shower/tub combo—ideal for family or friends
✔ Twin Nook: Creative twin sleeping space with a convenient trundle for extra guests

3rd Floor
✔ Twin Nook: Two twin-size beds, perfect for teens or younger guests to have their own fun space
✔ Cozy Hangout Area: Relax in this casual living space featuring a twin daybed and TV—ideal for movie nights, quiet downtime, or additional sleeping

★☆ LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ☆★

Watersound West is renowned for its exclusivity, stunning natural beauty, and access to 30A’s top attractions. Stroll over the dunes to the sugar white sands of the Emerald Coast or cruise the scenic route on one of the provided bikes. Nearby attractions include Deer Lake State Park, boutique shopping in Seaside, and waterfront dining options in the vibrant 30A community.

✔ WaterSound Private Beach Walk-Over - Just steps away, offering serene ocean views and the perfect place to unwind with the sound of waves.
✔ Deer Lake State Park - A 5-minute bike ride to a peaceful haven of untouched nature, ideal for a relaxing escape into scenic trails.
✔ Seagrove Beach - Only a 4-minute drive to this charming spot, full of laid-back vibes and beautiful sandy shores.
✔ Seaside Town Center - A 10-minute drive to a vibrant, picturesque community with unique shops, dining, and a lively coastal atmosphere.

★☆ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 4 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the front door of the home.

☆★ YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ☆★

At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

★☆ BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ☆★
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
